explanation: Iteration statements in C (loops) allow you to repeatedly execute a block of code based on a condition.  They are fundamental for controlling program flow and performing repetitive tasks efficiently.  C provides three main types: `while`, `do-while`, and `for` loops, each suited to different scenarios.
book: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie
keywords: C loops, C iteration statements, for while do-while C, C control flow
